name: imnet1k_park_bench
description: A small, focused vision benchmark derived from ImageNet-1k that collects images related to park and bench scenes. It is intended to measure image classification performance and robustness of models on this particular visual context and can be used for targeted evaluation or domain-specific fine‑tuning. The set is useful for studying performance differences on a semantically narrow subset of ImageNet.
reputation: A niche, task-specific subset used primarily for focused robustness or concept-level evaluation rather than broad community benchmarking.
